title: An Anisotropic Balian-Low Phenomenon: Geometric Obstructions to Wavelet Frames
summary: We investigate the analytic stability of wavelet frames in anisotropic Hardy spaces associated with expansive dilation matrices. The main result establishes a deterministic operator-norm lower bound on the reconstruction error of the mixed frame operator, uniformly across the Hardy range, whenever a real eigenvalue of the adjoint dilation exceeds a band-limited threshold imposed on a radial generator.
